obernants.operator: Distance0 admits every equal byte pair and does not recover inputs. BPE literals[97,98] and merged[256] both decode ab under a model whose first merge is(97,98). A full patch's Equal/Delete projection recovers source and Equal/Insert projection recovers target, but target alone admits many sources/scripts.
